title: Objects III: Design a Larger Program

steps.body: PLACEHOLDER: this chapter is still being written, and Snake ToolBox is not going to pretend otherwise. Here is where you will design a real multi-class application (dividing responsibility across classes, keeping data and behavior together, and a first taste of separating logic from I/O). It ships to your portfolio and becomes a candidate for your Phase 3 carry project. The full version is on the way. For now this page is an honest signpost of where the road goes next, not the lesson itself.
